children: Purchase of Own Securities and Total Voting Rights
Octopus AIM VCT 2 plc (the ‘Company’) announces that on 17 September 2026 the Company purchased for cancellation 520,361 ordinary shares of 0.01p each at a price of 30.6553p per share.

Following this transaction, the issued share capital and total voting rights of the Company will be 218,720,877 ordinary shares. This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
